summary: Independent read-only audit accepts the frozen HH16 package with one non-blocking editorial qualification. All 77 manifest-listed files match bytes, SHA-256, and full mode; the exact 79-file package set (including its two excluded envelopes), all raw-copy bindings, source/build bindings, and native chronology checks pass. No site output bodies were retained or independently rehashed.

copies_and_receipts.E2202_envelope: The package's duplicated root envelope exactly matches the root receipt. It records confirmed_reuse from the one-shot exit 0; H2's original worker result (SHA-256 6931e10190860ee52d765a541f56eca0aacd1830e79f099f5706044e37729e0e) is separately preserved with its original accepted decision and was not rewritten as a native failure.
copies_and_receipts.independent_review: R2203 H2 accepted result is byte-identical to the root receipt and preserved raw review evidence.

digest_algorithms.siteDigest: SHA-256(JSON.stringify(sorted output siteFiles[path,bytes,sha256])) from retained build-driver.mjs; independently recomputed and matched

build_receipt.qualification: Fresh receipt/log and output metadata support the captured 843-file build claim. The site tree is not in the package; this audit did not independently hash the 843 output bodies.

epoch_5_captured_state.interpretation: historical snapshot, not live state; the later E2205 result records mixed_change

native_chronology.copied_epoch_native_records: All epoch-00–04 bundles, solve JSON and root-command JSON plus next-packets, registry, spec, state-policy and E2202 envelope copies were compared bytewise to available original captures; all matched.
native_chronology.H1_H2_boundary_qualification: README and continuation distinguish H2's same-runtime new-controller probe from H1's new-provider/runtime case; the headline statement is collective and the precise limitation follows.
native_chronology.separate_lab: No Lab files are in the exact package set; native policy records Lab as separate. No Lab state was changed or treated as current by this audit.

wording_qualification.text: No email-retention defect was proven and no persistence behavior or provider capability was added.
wording_qualification.assessment: Stale domain-specific phrase in a profile-edit cycle. The surrounding continuation and README correctly describe profile-edit persistence, and no email behavior is asserted elsewhere. Non-blocking editorial qualification; it does not invalidate source, evidence, or build bindings. Do not silently alter the frozen package; root may correct it only in a future revision if desired.

evidence_limits: Synthetic fixture/controller/runtime and emitted-tree evidence only; no mounted DOM, native validity/FormData, backend, real account, email, screenshot, or human acceptance.
No site output tree was retained; siteDigest was recomputed from receipt metadata and is not a fresh body rehash.
Captured state/policy snapshots are epoch-time history, not current live-state assertions.
No tests, probes, builds, source edits, package edits, Git writes, or Lab operations were performed during this audit.
